# anthropic_spend_limit (Resource)

Manages a per-user Claude Enterprise spend limit override (`/v1/organizations/spend_limits`). To prevent accidental unlimited spend overrides when variables are null, you must configure **either** `amount` (in minor currency units / cents) **or** `unlimited = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Capped monthly spend limit ($150.00 = "15000" cents)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "engineer_monthly_cap" {
  user_id = "user_01J9ABCDEF"
  period  = "monthly"
  amount  = "15000"
}

# Explicit unlimited monthly spend override ("amount": null in the Anthropic API)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "principal_unlimited" {
  user_id   = "user_01J9XYZ123"
  period    = "monthly"
  unlimited = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the organization user to whom this spend limit applies.

### Optional

- `amount` (String) Spend cap in minor currency units (cents) as a string, e.g. `"10000"` for $100.00 or `"0"` for $0.00. Mutually exclusive with `unlimited = true`.
- `period` (String) Billing period for the spend limit. Currently only `monthly` is supported.
- `unlimited` (Boolean) Set to `true` to explicitly grant an unlimited spend override (`"amount": null` in the Anthropic API). Mutually exclusive with `amount`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the spend limit was created.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code returned by the API (e.g., `USD`).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the spend limit (`spl_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the spend limit was last updated.
